requirements.title: Write and maintain code
requirements.description: Produce clean, efficient, and well-documented code based on product specifications.
requirements.explanation: The candidate has demonstrated proficiency in full-stack development with React.js and Python/Flask, which aligns with the requirement to write and maintain code.

requirements.title: Participate in the full software development lifecycle (SDLC)
requirements.description: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers and designers, from ideation and requirements gathering to deployment and maintenance.
requirements.explanation: The candidate has experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver business intelligence solutions, directly meeting the SDLC participation requirement.

requirements.title: Design and develop software
requirements.description: Create and implement robust, scalable, and secure software applications, features, and systems.
requirements.explanation: The candidate has successfully designed and developed scalable business intelligence applications, which is evidence of their ability to design and develop software.

requirements.title: Debug and troubleshoot
requirements.description: Identify, diagnose, and resolve technical issues and bugs in existing software.
requirements.explanation: The candidate has a proven track record of troubleshooting complex issues, including RBAC system implementations and data visualization challenges.

requirements.title: Perform testing
requirements.description: Conduct unit, integration, and system tests to ensure software quality.
requirements.explanation: The candidate has experience in testing and debugging, as evidenced by their ability to resolve complex issues and ensure the functionality of their applications.

wishes.title: Excellent communication
wishes.explanation: The candidate has demonstrated clear documentation and communication skills, as evidenced by their comprehensive technical documentation and LinkedIn articles.

wishes.title: Passion for continuous learning
wishes.description: Show a commitment to learning and self-improvement.
wishes.explanation: The candidate has shown a passion for learning and sharing knowledge through LinkedIn articles about personal projects and technical topics.
